name: apple-mail-mcp
description: Read-only access to Apple Mail on macOS via Mail's local SQLite index and .emlx files.
long_description:
Searches and reads email directly from Apple Mail's local database (`~/Library/Mail/V10`) without AppleScript. Designed for large mailboxes (100K+ messages) with SQL-level filtering and pagination. Strictly read-only: no sending, moving or deleting.

**Requires Full Disk Access for the `uv` binary** (e.g. `~/.local/bin/uv`; System Settings → Privacy & Security → Full Disk Access) — Claude launches the server via `uv`, so granting it to Claude.app is not enough. Without it the server fails with `unable to open database file`.

tools.name: list_mailboxes
tools.description: List all mailboxes with message and unread counts

tools.name: search_emails
tools.description: Search and filter emails by sender, subject, date range, mailbox and read status (paginated)

tools.name: read_email
tools.description: Read the full content of a single email by ID
